summary: Verified Dashboard Display Currency feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 9 test cases in the review request pass. Backend curl tests confirmed: GET returns 6 supported currencies (USD/EUR/GBP/NGN/CAD/AUD) with symbol+code; PATCH persists (EUR round-trip verified); unsupported value 'XYZ' returns 400 with supported-list message; non-owned company id=9999 returns 403; no-auth returns 401. Frontend Playwright with JWT-injected localStorage confirmed: /settings?section=payments renders data-testid=display-currency-selector + data-testid=display-currency-select showing current USD; changing dropdown to EUR shows data-testid=display-currency-toast 'Dashboard currency updated' AND persists after full page reload; navigating to /dashboard renders balances with € symbol ('Today's Revenue €0.00 EUR', 'Lifetime Volume €17,653.99 EUR'); switching back to USD via the same UI restores '$' rendering ('$0.00 USD', '$20,061.35 USD'). Final DB state left at USD as required.
critical_code_review_comments: DisplayCurrencySelector swallows all errors from GET on mount (`catch {}`) — leaves select empty with no user-visible error, but acceptable given the non-blocking display-only nature of the preference.

Console errors observed during testing (next-auth CLIENT_FETCH_ERROR on /api/auth/session HTTP 400) are pre-existing and NOT caused by this feature — the app uses its own JWT via localStorage, not next-auth sessions.
